thread:
Maya: quick sync — we need a lightweight alerting + dashboard proto for 'queue shape' signals used by continuous batching. thinking: batch size distribution (p50/p90/p99), per-request wait_time_ms (p50/p95), fill_rate (how often a batch was emitted full vs timed), and a saturation indicator for workers/shards. want API + console owners to agree on canonical metrics and a small alerting surface first :eyes:

Kevin: +1. are these runtime-exposed already or do we need infra aggregation?

Jonah: runtime emits histograms for batch_size and wait_ms on each worker (Prometheus). we currently have: `redwood_runtime_batch_size` (histogram), `redwood_runtime_batch_wait_ms` (histogram), `redwood_worker_queue_depth` (gauge). but no canonical "fill_rate" metric — can derive it from counts of full_batch vs emitted_batch (we have counters `batch_emitted_total` and `batch_full_total`).

Sree: okay good. infra side: we prefer emitting pre-aggregated 1m counters to avoid high-cardinality joins. can runtime add a `batch_fill_ratio` gauge emitted per-process every 60s? that'd make alert queries simpler.

Maya: that sounds right. for the console, we want a single "queue shape" panel that shows a small set of sparklines: p50/p95 batch size, p95 wait_ms, fill_ratio, and an occupancy heatmap. UX should default to 15m window with selectable 1h/6h/24h.

Ana: for alerts, suggest two thresholds: (1) sustained p95 wait_ms > 300ms for 5m (indicates latency regression), (2) fill_ratio < 0.5 and batch_size_p50 < target for 10m (indicates underfill/burst). these are generic, teams can tune. want to surface the alert in console routes + paging.

Kevin: routing/quotas interplay: if a tenant is hitting quota and we throttle, fill_ratio will drop and wait_ms may go up. we should tag metrics with `tenant_plan` or at least `customer_tier` so alerts can be scoped to dedicated vs hosted. is that feasible?

Jonah: exposing tenant dimension at high cardinality is risky. propose we emit an aggregated `tenant_tier` label only for 3 buckets: hosted_free, hosted_paid, dedicated. runtime can map customer flags and expose that label on the pre-aggregated gauge. infra can roll up if teams want per-tenant drilling but default dashboard uses tier aggregates.

Sree: agreed. infra will accept those 3-tier labels. we'll also implement a low-cardinality `/v1/metrics/queue-shape` rollup endpoint for console panels (prometheus -> aggregator -> cached endpoint) to avoid heavy dashboard queries.

Maya: nice. quick proto for PromQLs to drive panels/alerts: ```
# p95 batch wait in ms
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_runtime_batch_wait_ms_bucket[5m])) by (le))

# p95 batch size
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_runtime_batch_size_bucket[5m])) by (le))

# fill ratio (if runtime doesn't emit gauge)
sum(rate(batch_full_total[5m])) / sum(rate(batch_emitted_total[5m]))
```

Ana: for the alert rules yaml I'd suggest something like: ```yaml
- alert: QueueP95High
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_runtime_batch_wait_ms_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 0.3
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
- alert: LowFillRatio
  expr: sum(rate(batch_full_total[10m])) / sum(rate(batch_emitted_total[10m])) < 0.5
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: ticket
```

Maya: love that. two follow-ups: (A) ownership doc / metric registry entry so Console links the metric name to source + owner; (B) small lightweight dashboard template that teams can clone into their org in Console.

Kevin: I'll take ownership of metric registry entries + Console panel wiring. ETA EOW?

Jonah: I'll add the `batch_fill_ratio` gauge emitted every 60s and include `tenant_tier` label; I'll also instrument exported histograms to make sure buckets align across versions. PR by Wed.

Sree: infra: we'll add the cached rollup endpoint and a Prometheus recording rule to back the console queries. also add a sampling/ingest quota check so dashboard queries can't blow up. ETA next Tue.

Ana: I'll draft the alert playbook steps (what to check: routing fallback, quota throttles, shard saturation, model fallback) and a short runbook text for oncall. will share draft tomorrow.

Maya: thanks all. action items recap: Kevin - metric registry + console tile (EOW); Jonah - runtime gauge + labels PR (Wed); Sree - rollup endpoint + recording rules (Tue); Ana - alert playbook (tomorrow). ops-bot: create an umbrella ticket and link prs? :robot_face:

ops-bot: Created ticket RW-2387 "Queue shape alerting + console panel (proto)" and added checklist items.

Maya: We'll reconvene after PRs land to finalize alert thresholds and add the dashboard template to the Console gallery. If anyone wants different thresholds per model class we can make them per-team tunables later — for now keep defaults conservative. :thumbsup:
